name: Jax
_comment_paths: base_blend (master .blend containing the armature) and blender_exe (Steam Blender binary) are machine-specific. Do NOT commit personal absolute paths to this public repo. Supply them via process_take CLI flags (--base-blend / --blender-exe), the MELODICCAP_BLENDER env var, or an untracked characters/jax.local.json that deep-merges over this file.
_comment_bvh_export: global_rot_euler_deg 'auto' resolves from the pose JSON's coordinate_frame tag: gravity-aligned y_up_world JSONs (current converter output) get no correction, legacy camera-frame JSONs get the historical [180, 0, 0] upright flip. Set an explicit [x, y, z] to override. root_motion 'zero' pins the root (keyframe the walk path by hand); switch to 'trans' per-take for travelling takes so the foot-contact IK lock works WITH the walk instead of against a pinned root.
_comment_bone_map: Proven SMPL (BVH source joint) -> JaxRigify map for the headless Rokoko retarget. Drives bpy.ops.rsl.retarget_animation() via Rokoko's bone-list collection. Rokoko handles rest-pose alignment, auto-scaling, and IK target placement -- so this map mirrors the user's known-good manual Rokoko bone list exactly (22 pairs: 18 rotation + 4 IK end-effectors). The `type` field is documentation-only; Rokoko infers behavior from source/target bone names. Collars intentionally omitted.
_comment_calibration: Optional per-target-bone escape hatch, reserved for future use (current Rokoko engine does not consume it). Default: none.
_comment_foot_contact: Phase 4 foot-contact + IK lock post-pass. Detects plant frames from SMPL ankle Z + XY velocity (data-relative floor calibrated from the first `calibration_frames` of the take, median). Headless retarget then keys foot_ik.{L,R} location/rotation toward the planted Rokoko-baked snapshot during each interval (with smoothstep blend on entry and exit), and ramps thigh_parent.{L,R} IK_FK from 1.0 (FK during swing) to 0.0 (IK during plant). Defaults are the v5.x music-video constants. Set enabled=false (or pass --no-foot-contact) to bypass and reproduce today's behavior bit-for-bit.
_comment_about_offsets: rot_offset_euler_deg is added AFTER the SMPL axis-angle is converted to a Blender quaternion. Use it to absorb mismatches between SMPL's joint frame and the Rigify bone's roll. Common values are 0 / +/- 90 / +/- 180. Edit these during Phase F calibration when you see a bone rotated wrong on a real take.
_comment_about_root: Options: 'ignore' (best for Path A monocular — drift-prone; keyframe walk path by hand), 'follow' (use SMPL trans as-is), 'follow_xy' (XY only, hold Z at rest — useful for sit/stand transitions).

axis_conversion._comment: Whole-armature rotation applied to the rig OBJECT before per-bone rotations. JaxRigify is already built standing upright in Blender's Z-up world, so the rest pose (all-zero SMPL rotations) should land on Jax's existing T-pose — no whole-body rotation needed. SMPL/Blender axis differences are handled per-bone via rot_offset_euler_deg above. Keep this at [0, 0, 0] unless a future character needs the whole rig flipped (e.g. an asset imported from a Y-up DCC). If a real take comes in lying on its face, fix the per-bone offsets, NOT this value.
